nodes.label: Final Pre-Flight Check
nodes.rationale: Last filter; if any box fails the output is not done.

nodes.label: The Three Dials
nodes.rationale: Every layout, motion and density decision is gated by these; baseline 8/6/4.

nodes.label: Player Autoplay
nodes.rationale: Disabled under reduced motion; carousel responds to arrow keys.

nodes.label: Taste Skill (design-taste-frontend)
nodes.rationale: Anti-slop frontend skill: infer the brief first so output does not look templated; rules are contextual, not automatic.

nodes.label: Anti-Center Bias
nodes.rationale: Centered hero avoided when DESIGN_VARIANCE > 4; use split screen or asymmetric layouts.

nodes.label: Anti-Default Discipline
nodes.rationale: Avoid LLM defaults: AI-purple gradients, centered hero, three equal cards, generic glassmorphism, Inter + slate-900.

nodes.label: Bento Exact Cell Count
nodes.rationale: N items -> N cells, no empty cells.

nodes.label: Brief Inference (Section 0)
nodes.rationale: Most LLM design output is bad because it jumps to a default aesthetic instead of reading the room.

nodes.label: Em-Dash Ban
nodes.rationale: Em-dash is the LLM's signature crutch and #1 visual tell; zero tolerance, binary rule.

nodes.label: Hero Stack Discipline
nodes.rationale: Max 4 text elements in hero; subtext <= 20 words.

nodes.label: No Duplicate CTA Intent
nodes.rationale: One label per intent (contact, signup, portfolio).

nodes.label: Page Theme Lock
nodes.rationale: Page has one theme; sections do not invert.

nodes.label: Reduced Motion (mandatory)
nodes.rationale: Any motion above MOTION_INTENSITY 3 must honor prefers-reduced-motion.

nodes.label: Shape Consistency Lock
nodes.rationale: One corner-radius system; mixed allowed only with a documented rule followed everywhere.

nodes.label: Design Read (Portfolio)
nodes.rationale: Dev portfolio for recruiters and tech leads, music-player frosted-glass language, native CSS glassmorphism, fluid restrained motion.

nodes.label: Dial Values 7/6/4
nodes.rationale: VARIANCE 7 = dev preset 6 +1 for striking visual; MOTION 6 for fluid animations; DENSITY 4 for quick recruiter reading.

nodes.label: Animation Rationale Table
nodes.rationale: Every animation must communicate something; transform/opacity only; stops under reduced motion.

nodes.label: Shape Rule (pill / 24px / 12px)
nodes.rationale: Documented radius rule: controls pill, surfaces rounded-surface 24px, thumbnails rounded-thumb 12px.

nodes.label: Apple Liquid Glass Honest Web Approximation
nodes.norm_label: apple liquid glass honest web approximation
nodes.rationale: No official Apple web CSS exists; backdrop-filter glass is web glassmorphism and must be labeled as such.

nodes.label: Self-hosted Fonts (Sora Variable, JetBrains Mono)
nodes.rationale: No Google Fonts <link>.

nodes.label: Future Ideas
nodes.rationale: Project detail page ('song lyrics'), Wrapped retrospective, auto descriptions from READMEs.

nodes.label: glass Utility (Frosted Glass)
nodes.rationale: Web approximation with backdrop-filter, inner border and highlight; not Apple Liquid Glass; solid fallback for prefers-reduced-transparency.

nodes.label: Music Player Theme
nodes.rationale: Inspired by three references: frosted-glass player cards, orbit lines, album coverflow with player bar.

nodes.label: Phosphor Icons
nodes.rationale: SSR import for Server Components, regular import for Client Components.

nodes.label: Theme System and Toggle
nodes.rationale: Follows system by default; toggle persists to localStorage; all colors via CSS variables.

nodes.label: Remaining Work (TODO)
nodes.rationale: Real photo, real texts, GitHub user/token, real skills, resume PDF, OG image.

nodes.label: Portfolio Now Playing
nodes.rationale: Personal dev portfolio showing skills and GitHub projects with a music-player theme.

nodes.label: Dark Mode Protocol
nodes.rationale: Design both modes from the start; CSS variables or dark: variant, one strategy per project.

nodes.label: Next.js Breaking Changes Notice
nodes.rationale: This Next.js version differs from training data; read node_modules/next/dist/docs before coding.

nodes.label: Editable Content Centralization Rule
nodes.rationale: Editable content lives in src/content/site.ts; do not scatter text across components.

nodes.label: Color Consistency Lock
nodes.rationale: One accent locked across the whole page; max 1 accent, saturation < 80%.

nodes.label: The Lila Rule
nodes.rationale: AI purple/blue glow discouraged as default; use neutral bases with a singular accent.

nodes.label: Project Covers by Luminance (cv-a, cv-b, cv-c)
nodes.norm_label: project covers by luminance (cv-a, cv-b, cv-c)
nodes.rationale: Covers vary by luminance, not color, to respect the single-accent rule.

nodes.label: Single Amber Accent #E8A33D
nodes.rationale: One accent across the page; --accent-deep #805A22 for light-mode contrast; only green is the real 'Available' state dot.
